display_long_description:
**A Next-Generation VR Tower Defense Game**

**Strategic Deployment. Maximum Firepower. Take Back the Battlefield.**

The invasion wasn’t a warning; it was a total takeover. Alien machines have descended on Earth with a singular, brutal objective: strip the planet’s Power Core and leave nothing behind. They’ve already wiped out our primary defenses, and now, they’re coming for the heart of our world.

[media]

As the commander of Strike Command, you are the last line of defense. But in this war, you don’t just sit behind a desk and watch dots on a map. You are the most lethal weapon on the field. Whether you’re orchestrating a complex grid of turrets or jumping into the heat of the action yourself, the fate of the planet rests on your aim.

[media]

**Manual Overdrive**

Sometimes, automation isn't enough. At any moment, you can dive into any turret and take manual control. While you’re in the seat, attack power surges by 50%. This isn't just a change in perspective—it’s how you break a stalemate and crush a breakthrough.

[media]

**Loadout Strategy**

Victory is decided before the first shot is even fired. Choose three core turrets from your arsenal to bring into the fight. Every map demands a different approach, and your ability to match your gear to the enemy's path is what keeps the Power Core intact.

[media]

**Global Leaderboards**

See how you stack up against the best commanders on the planet. With separate rankings for Easy, Normal, and Hard modes, you’ll need to refine your tactics and master your timing to claim the top spot.
